newsitem.title: UK: Zinc hits fresh highs since August 1990 in AM kerb.
newsitem.headline: Zinc hits fresh highs since August 1990 in AM kerb.

text.p: ZINC - Buoyant. Ends kerb at $1,542, up $18 and highest since August 1990.
COPPER - Firmer at $2,333, up $17. But turns back at $2,335 resistance. Borrowing in August/threes pushes out spread to firmer $140/$150 backwardation.
ALUMINIUM - Holding steady at slightly firmer levels above $1,600, but resistance at $1,620. NICKEL - Firmer just above $6,800. LEAD - Up with zinc. OTHERS - Quiet.
